import zipfile, shutil, re, sys, os

SRC = "quarterly_report.docx"
TMP = "quarterly_report_edit"
OUT = "quarterly_report.docx"

def underline_headlines():
    # Extract the docx
    with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as z:
        names = z.namelist()
        data = {n: z.read(n) for n in names}

    xml = data["word/document.xml"].decode("utf-8")
    print("document.xml length:", len(xml))

    # Find headline paragraphs. Headlines are typically short paragraphs styled with
    # Heading1/Heading2 or bold runs. Inspect first.
    # Save original xml for inspection
    with open("document_orig.xml", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(xml)

    # Underline all runs in paragraphs whose pStyle is a Heading style,
    # or that look like headlines (short bold all-caps/title text).
    # We add <w:u w:val="single"/> inside each run's rPr.
    import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
    ns = {"w": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"}
    for pfx in ns:
        ET.register_namespace(pfx, ns[pfx])

    tree = ET.fromstring(xml)
    body = tree.find("w:body", ns)
    changed = 0
    for p in body.iter("{%s}p" % ns["w"]):
        pPr = p.find("w:pPr", ns)
        style = ""
        if pPr is not None:
            pStyle = pPr.find("w:pStyle", ns)
            if pStyle is not None:
                style = pStyle.get("{%s}val" % ns["w"]) or ""
        text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in p.iter("{%s}t" % ns["w"]))
        is_heading = style.lower().startswith("heading") or "title" in style.lower()
        if not is_heading:
            continue
        # underline all runs in this heading paragraph
        for r in p.findall("w:r", ns):
            rPr = r.find("w:rPr", ns)
            if rPr is None:
                rPr = ET.SubElement(r, "{%s}rPr" % ns["w"])
                # rPr must come first
                r.remove(rPr)
                r.insert(0, rPr)
            u = rPr.find("w:u", ns)
            if u is None:
                u = ET.SubElement(rPr, "{%s}u" % ns["w"])
            u.set("{%s}val" % ns["w"], "single")
            changed += 1
        print("HEADING style=%r text=%r" % (style, text))
    print("Runs underlined:", changed)

    new_xml = ET.tostring(tree, encoding="unicode", xml_declaration=True)
    data["word/document.xml"] = new_xml.encode("utf-8")

    # Rewrite zip
    if os.path.exists(OUT):
        os.remove(OUT)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        for n in names:
            z.writestr(n, data[n])
    print("Wrote", OUT)

underline_headlines()
